gloss: making the bench; being selected for the game-day roster

definitions.gloss: making the bench; being selected for the game-day roster
definitions.explanation: Being included in the group of players who sit on the bench during a game, meaning they are eligible to play as substitutes. Used primarily in baseball and other team sports in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧ベンチ{入|い}り⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
ベンチ{入|い}り⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

ケガ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}して→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ベンチ{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The player who returned from injury and made the bench for the first time in a while showed tears.

notes:
A compound of ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧ (bench) + {入|い}り (entering, being included). In Japanese sports, especially ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧ (baseball) and ⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧ (soccer), ベンチ{入|い}り means being selected to the active roster for a game. It does not necessarily mean the player will play -- they may remain on the bench as a substitute.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベンチ{入|い}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make the bench (verb form)
- ベンチ{入|い}り⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧: bench roster members
- ベンチ{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve bench selection
- ベンチ{入|い}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss bench selection

CONTRASTED WITH:
- ⟦スタメン→スタメン：06589_sutamen⟧ / ⟦{先発|せんぱつ}→先発：17735_senpatsu⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧: starting lineup -- players who start the game
- ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧: not on the bench -- not selected for the game-day roster at all
- ⟦{控|ひか}え{選手|せんしゅ}→控え選手：20951_hikaesenshu⟧: reserve player, substitute

USAGE:
For young or recovering players, ベンチ{入|い}り itself is an achievement and milestone, even if they do not get playing time.
